_about: The upper High Tower of Magic (levels 8-50): the golems wake together, the witches help each other, the golems and the Necromancer are elites, the three Masters (Neutrality, the Black Robes, Goodness) are sub-bosses, and the Grand Mistress in the Audience Chamber burns glyphs into the floor and opens the tower's eyes on you.
